notes.title: Playtest now Available!
notes.content:
Again a huge thank you to anyone who has tried out MUST FIND BEANS. Today I am opening up a limited playtest for anyone to try out the current experience.

Along with this, there are several additions and fixes that have been made. Most importantly, logs can now be found at the current locations depending on your system OS. It would be great if you could include the relevant log for the crash when reporting an issue. If you like, reports and feedback can be left as comments in the discussions of this announcement.

 Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\MUST FIND BEANS\logs
 Linux: ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/MUST FIND BEANS/logs

Fixes and additions
Steam

 Added Steam Leaderboard support for level times
 Added a Steam Achievement for achieving a sub 10 second time on Level 1
 Steam Cloud Saves are set to share storage with the main game, meaning that upon release all relevant playtest data should be present 

Visuals

 Increased contrast of UI elements for better readability
 Added skylight shafts to better visual breakup of the first level
 Darkened the starting room

Audio

 Added adjustable audio levels for Music and SFX
 Enemies now emit a firing sound when attacking the player, with their projectiles also emitting an audible note

Other

 Fixed a possible crash that could occur when loading save data that may not exist yet
 Fixed the player not being able to slide on steep ramps
 Fixed enemies possibly dropping more than pickup on death
 Added a new bind: Q, to quickly reset level progress
 Added a queued notification system for pickups and other messages
 Increased the player's maximum health from 100 to 150

If you encounter any bugs, please continue to report them. Reports like these make it much easier to catch a wider range of issues and address them faster.

notes.title: Cloud Saves are now Enabled
notes.content:
A huge thanks to everyone who has taken any time to playtest the game in its current state, all your feedback is greatly appreciated and I am working to integrate fixes and build upon any recommendations that have been made.

I've enabled Steam Cloud Saves now as I am pretty certain there are no logic errors in saving this data. If you have any issues with it not saving, saving incorrect data, or anything else, do please let me know.

To go alongside this, there will now be a ghost you can race through the level which will be a copy of your movements from your best level time record. Hopefully this will make it more visual to see your current level progress in comparison to previous efforts.

Smaller fixes

 Level time is now unaffected by time-slow effects such as the beam weapon type
 Visual changes made to key art and on screen UI elements to better separate each element
 Distance based projectile damage drop-off for blast weapon type
 Randomized recoil when spray weapon type is held for an extended time
 Initial level's first staircase side has been lowered to allow possible skip

If you encounter any bugs, please continue to report them. Reports like these make it much easier to catch a wider range of issues and address them faster.
